summary: Implemented the unknown-total speed indicator in rich/progress.py: track() gained show_speed (default True) passed to TaskProgressColumn; TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a static render_speed, a render branch for unknown total with show_speed, and a full Google-style class docstring; Progress.track now infers total as explicit, else len for Sized, else None without raising. Updated tests/test_progress.py by removing the two ValueError assertions and adding test_task_progress_column_speed, and added a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added line. Nothing was committed, and tests, mypy, and black were not run because the instructions barred running repository code, so those checks are unverified.
